basic_details.job_title: APSSB Constable, Fireman and Other Post Exam Date 2026 - Schedule Released
basic_details.short_information: The Arunachal Pradesh Staff Selection Board (APSSB) has issued an official notice dated 6th July 2026 announcing the Stage-II examination schedule for the Special Recruitment Drive under the Uniformed Services Combined Examination (USCE)-2026. Provisionally shortlisted candidates will undergo the Physical Standard Test (PST), Physical Efficiency Test (PET), and Trade Test starting 13th July 2026 at the Police Training Centre, Banderdewa.

important_dates.raw: Candidates exempted from PET/PST but shortlisted under Post Code 5/26 (Constable Band) and 6/26 (Constable Bugler) must appear separately for the Trade Test. This test is scheduled from 23rd July 2026 to 26th July 2026, organized into four batches, with roll numbers listed in the official notice.

rows.information: Special Recruitment Drive for Uniformed Services Combined Examination-2026

content_sections.heading: Which Posts Are Covered Under This Recruitment Drive?
content_sections.text: This APSSB notice applies to candidates shortlisted for multiple uniformed service posts. Below is the list of post codes and designations included in the Stage-II schedule. Constable Band (IRBn) - Post Code 5/26 Constable Bugler (IRBn) - Post Code 6/26 Constable IRBn - Post Code 7/26 Constable Civil Police (Female) - Post Code 8/26 Constable Civil Police (Male) - Post Code 9/26 Fireman - Post Code 10/26 Special Tiger Guard - Post Code 11/26

content_sections.heading: PET & PST One-Time Exemption: Who Is Eligible?
content_sections.text: APSSB has granted a one-time exemption from PET and PST to a specific group of candidates. This section explains who qualifies and what they still need to complete. Important: This exemption does not cover the Trade Test. Exempted candidates under Post Codes 5/26 (Constable Band) and 6/26 (Constable Bugler) must still appear for the Trade Test.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required at the Test Venue
content_sections.text: Candidates must carry specific documents to be allowed entry into the examination venue. Missing documents can lead to disqualification from the test. Admit Card issued for the Special Recruitment Drive for Uniformed Services Combined Examination-2026 Photo identity proof as mentioned in the admit card

content_sections.heading: Batch-Wise PST, PET & Trade Test Schedule (13 July - 26 July 2026)
content_sections.text: APSSB has divided candidates into multiple batches across different dates. Candidates should check their roll number carefully against the official batch schedule to confirm their exact test date. Each batch contains hundreds of roll numbers arranged in numerical order. Candidates are strongly advised to download and check the to locate their specific roll number and confirm the assigned date and batch number.

content_sections.heading: Trade Test Schedule for Post Code 5/26 & 6/26
content_sections.text: Candidates exempted from PET/PST but shortlisted under Post Code 5/26 (Constable Band) and 6/26 (Constable Bugler) must appear separately for the Trade Test. This test is scheduled from 23rd July 2026 to 26th July 2026, organized into four batches, with roll numbers listed in the official notice.

content_sections.heading: Guidelines for Candidates: What to Wear and Carry
content_sections.text: APSSB has issued specific instructions regarding clothing and essential items for the PET, PST, and Trade Test to ensure smooth conduct of the examination. Wear comfortable sportswear: T-shirt, shorts/track pants, and sports shoes Avoid tight, heavy, or restrictive clothing Candidates appearing for the 14 KM and 25 KM walk events (Post Code 11/26 - Special Tiger Guard) should carry caps and umbrellas or raincoats due to summer heat and unpredictable rain Drinking water will be available at the venue, but candidates may carry their own water bottles

faq.question: Q1. When was the APSSB Exam Date 2026 released?
faq.answer: The APSSB Exam Date 2026 was released on 06 July 2026 on the official portal apssb.nic.in.

faq.question: Q2. When will the APSSB PET/PST/Trade Test 2026 begin?
faq.answer: The Stage-II examination (PST, PET, and Trade Test) will begin on 13th July 2026 and continue in batches through 26th July 2026 at the Police Training Centre, Banderdewa.

faq.question: Q3. What is the reporting time for the APSSB PET/PST 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must report by 6:30 AM. The gate entry closes strictly at 8:30 AM, and no candidate will be permitted entry after this time.

faq.question: Q4. Who is exempted from PET and PST in APSSB USCE-2026?
faq.answer: Candidates who already qualified PET/PST and appeared in the written exam held on 13.07.2025 under Advertisement No. 09/2020, for Post Codes 5/26, 6/26, 8/26, and 9/26, are exempted from PET & PST but must still appear for the Trade Test (for Post Codes 5/26 and 6/26 only).

faq.question: Q5. What documents are required for the APSSB Stage-II test?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their Admit Card issued for the Special Recruitment Drive USCE-2026 and a valid photo identity proof matching the admit card details.
